mapper.select: SELECT tenant_id AS tenantId, provider AS provider, model_name AS modelName, currency AS currency, COALESCE(SUM(call_count), 0) AS callCount, COALESCE(SUM(input_tokens), 0) AS inputTokens, COALESCE(SUM(output_tokens), 0) AS outputTokens, COALESCE(SUM(cached_tokens), 0) AS cachedTokens, COALESCE(SUM(total_tokens), 0) AS totalTokens, COALESCE(SUM(model_segment_count), 0) AS modelSegmentCount, COALESCE(SUM(settled_segment_count), 0) AS settledSegmentCount, COALESCE(SUM(unsettled_segment_count), 0) AS unsettledSegmentCount, CASE WHEN SUM(settled_segment_count) = SUM(model_segment_count) AND SUM(model_segment_count) > 0 THEN 'COMPLETE' WHEN SUM(settled_segment_count) = 0 THEN 'UNAVAILABLE' ELSE 'PARTIAL' END AS pricingStatus, COALESCE(SUM(amount), 0) AS amount FROM cw_tenant_usage_daily WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND stat_date BETWEEN #{from} AND #{to} GROUP BY tenant_id, provider, model_name, currency ORDER BY amount DESC
